name: app/account-menu
title: AccountMenu
summary: Who is signed in, the app's account actions, and sign-out as a POST form, in a <details> disclosure at the end of the top bar.

props.name: signOutAction
props.description: Where the sign-out form posts; omit to leave sign-out to the slot.

slots.name: default
slots.description: Account actions: an appearance form, links.

behaviour: Initials in a 24px avatar; the name shows from xl and is the accessible name below it.
Sign-out is a POST form, so no other page can trigger it with a link.

keyboard: Enter/Space opens; Tab through the panel.

theming.brandOverlay: The focus ring follows the brand's `--ring`. Nothing else changes: layout, spacing, type and every other colour are the same in every brand.

noJs.without: Everything: the component is server-rendered HTML with no script.

responsive: The name shows from xl; the panel is min(18rem, 100vw − 1rem) wide, right-aligned.
contract:
contract
  slot is "account-menu"
  summary "Tendai Moyo" min_height 32
  when default shows button "Sign out"
  when anonymous shows summary "Your account"
end
